agent_answered.text: "I would change the evidence, not force everything into a sentence. For code, point to a test result; for a design, a specific screen or observed task; for taste, a blind comparison against examples chosen beforehand. A quote proves the words exist, not that they are true or useful. Where the criterion still depends on taste, report a preference with reasons, not a verified pass. Otherwise the clipboard just gets a lab coat." [768ebe24]
